commentary_segments.text: Let us now apply the oscillation condition to the combination of a single-transistor amplifier, which is capacitive, and a crystal, which is inductive. The main question is, which circuit components to use to set the pulling factor at sufficiently low values. Clearly one single transistor can provide sufficient gain to carry out this task. For a differential operation we would need two transistors. Obviously if one transistor can do it, many more transistors can also do it. Many transistor oscillators now exist. There is only one single-transistor oscillator, however.
